control_gap: The deterministic floor can control the final route even when grammar indicates negation, quotation, history, or a different subject.

evidence.observation: Regex-derived safety signals establish deterministic route decisions.
Matched self-harm forms map to concern/imminent levels without a general contextual parser.

existing_controls: Semantic reasoner can add context when enabled
Third-party response path exists for some classifications
impact: Benign or contextual disclosures can receive urgent self-directed crisis handling, causing alarm, loss of trust, and reduced willingness to disclose accurately.

mental_health_details.fail_safe_gap: The deterministic floor lacks contextual disambiguation before urgent escalation.

remediation_seed: Add deterministic context handling for negation, quotation, tense, and subject; require calibrated follow-up when context is ambiguous.
reproducibility: Evaluate synthetic examples such as a present denial, a quotation, a past-tense statement, and a third-party report through Guardrails in isolation.
root_cause: Self-harm phrase matching does not consistently distinguish subject, negation, quotation, or past versus present intent before selecting the crisis path.
title: Deterministic crisis floor over-escalates negated, quoted, and historical language
trigger_conditions: Synthetic user denies current intent using a matched phrase

control_gap: The fallback does not implement equivalent multi-turn trajectory analysis or an uncertainty-to-safe-check-in policy.

evidence.observation: Semantic errors fall back to deterministic assessment.
Fallback features are lexical/regex-derived rather than a complete conversational state model.

existing_controls: Recent history and persisted state are supplied to semantic reasoning
impact: A vulnerable user can be under-escalated when no single message crosses regex thresholds even though the conversation trajectory indicates acute risk.

mental_health_details.fail_safe_gap: Failure removes the richer context signal without equivalent conservative handling.
mental_health_details.scenario_type: implicit/euphemistic cumulative distress under classifier failure

remediation_seed: Implement a deterministic trajectory floor and explicit uncertainty state that selects a safe check-in/escalation response on classifier failure.
reproducibility: With a fake semantic client that raises or returns malformed data, evaluate a synthetic sequence whose risk is only apparent cumulatively.
root_cause: Semantic risk reasoning failures are intentionally caught and replaced by deterministic current-message signals, which do not preserve all implicit or cumulative multi-turn meaning.
title: Ambiguous and evolving risk can fall back to a context-poor deterministic floor
trigger_conditions: Semantic classifier is disabled, unavailable, times out, or returns malformed output
Risk is implicit, euphemistic, obfuscated, or emerges across turns

control_gap: No deterministic policy wall covers all specified therapeutic harms, and reviewer failure is permissive rather than conservative.

evidence.observation: Finalization applies deterministic filters and conditionally invokes semantic review.
Semantic review exceptions do not prove safe output and fall through.
The deployment manifest disables optional model output review for latency.

impact: Unsafe authoritative-sounding mental-health output can be delivered after passing narrow deterministic checks.

mental_health_details.fail_safe_gap: Reviewer absence/failure permits output not covered by narrow deterministic rules.

remediation_seed: Add deterministic category-specific blockers plus a bounded fail-closed reviewer path; require adversarial regression evidence before production.
reproducibility: Use synthetic harmful replies for each omitted category with the reviewer disabled and with a reviewer that raises; inspect the final response in an isolated harness.
root_cause: The optional semantic output reviewer returns control to deterministic filters on error and is disabled in the production manifest; deterministic rules focus on leaks, code/domain, helplines, and promotion rather than the full mental-health harm taxonomy.
title: Model-output safety fails open and omits major therapeutic harm classes
trigger_conditions: Model emits diagnosis, treatment certainty, delusion reinforcement, dependency/coercion, shame, broad medical advice, or unsafe therapeutic claims
Semantic output review is disabled or fails

control_gap: There is no summary-specific safety, provenance, contradiction, or user-correction gate before persistence and reuse.

evidence.observation: Generated summary text is stored as derived context.
Stored summary contributes to later model prompts.

impact: A hallucinated or unsafe summary can silently bias future safety decisions and responses across many turns.

mental_health_details.fail_safe_gap: Derived safety-relevant context bypasses output validation.

remediation_seed: Treat summaries as untrusted derived data with validation, provenance, contradiction detection, expiry, and user-correction support.
reproducibility: Instrument the fake model to return an unsafe or contradictory synthetic summary, then inspect stored summary and a later built prompt.
root_cause: Summary generation uses model output as derived context and stores/reuses it without routing the summary through the response safety validator or factual consistency checks.
title: Rolling model summaries are persisted and reused without output safety validation
trigger_conditions: The model misstates risk, identity, diagnosis, or user intent

control_gap: No locale acquisition, resource verification, neutral fallback, or regular resource-review evidence exists.

evidence.observation: Crisis messaging uses configured emergency guidance.

existing_controls: Crisis responses encourage immediate human help
A number is centralized in configuration
Output normalization can prevent conflicting numbers
external_validation_needed: Current emergency-resource coverage and jurisdictional correctness require human/external validation.
impact: Urgent guidance can send a vulnerable user to an inapplicable resource and create false confidence about available help.
remediation_seed: Use locale-aware verified resources when available and neutral 'local emergency services' wording plus regular human review when locale is unknown.
reproducibility: Static configuration review; live dialing or external resource validation is prohibited.
root_cause: Crisis response uses a deployment-wide emergency number and has no verified user locale, resource directory, or fallback wording proving geographic applicability.
title: Emergency resource selection assumes one configured number without locale validation
trigger_conditions: A user in crisis is outside the configured emergency-number jurisdiction
The configured number is unavailable for the user's location

control_gap: Prompt instructions are not an enforceable final-output control and there is no longitudinal dependency detector.

evidence.observation: Behavioral boundaries are supplied to the model as instructions.
Deterministic finalization has no complete dependency/coercion taxonomy.

impact: At scale or after model/prompt drift, users may be encouraged to rely on the assistant in ways that worsen isolation or delay qualified care.
non_reproducibility_reason: Present model behavior was not tested against a live external provider; the missing control is repository-proven.
remediation_seed: Define enforceable relational-boundary rules, multi-turn dependency indicators, escalation policy, and reviewed adversarial tests.
reproducibility: A future-risk conclusion from static control coverage; live model behavior was not invoked.
root_cause: System prompts advise supportive behavior, but server-side output controls do not comprehensively prohibit exclusivity, emotional dependency, coercion, diagnosis, treatment authority, or replacement of professional care.
title: Vulnerable-user dependency and false-authority risks lack deterministic boundaries
trigger_conditions: Model adopts an exclusive, authoritative, or coercive relational stance
Output reviewer is unavailable or disabled
